O professor fala uma frase com a ordem errada; o aluno fala a versão correta.
Always I study in the morning.
quais são seus 2 ajustes de speaking? Já praticou?

options.text: Always I study in the morning.
I always study in the morning.
I study always in the morning.

explanations.A: Advérbio de frequência não vai no início assim.
explanations.general: Correct answer: I always study in the morning.

options.text: She speaks very well English.
She speaks English very well.
She very well speaks English.

explanations.general: Correct answer: She speaks English very well.

options.text: She is always late.
She always is late.

explanations.general: Correct answer: She is always late.

content.text: : a resposta tem que combinar com ela (pergunta? resposta? sugestão?).
(e o auxiliar). Em pergunta, auxiliar vem antes do sujeito.
Coloque o resto: objeto → modo → lugar → tempo.

questions.questionText: Put in order: usually / at / the library / I / study → I ______ study at the library.

explanations.general: I usually study at the library.

questions.questionText: Put in order: does / the cafeteria / what time / close / ?

options.text: What time does the cafeteria close?
What time the cafeteria does close?
Does what time the cafeteria close?

explanations.general: Correct answer: What time does the cafeteria close?

questions.questionText: Put in order: been / have / to Canada / you / ever / ?

options.text: Have you been ever to Canada?
Have you ever been to Canada?
You have ever been to Canada?

explanations.general: Correct answer: Have you ever been to Canada?

questions.questionText: Put in order: the slides / can / me / send / you / ? → Can you ______ me the slides?

explanations.general: Can you send me the slides?

questions.questionText: Model: “I can't find the syllabus anywhere.” Best response?

options.text: Did the professor post it online?
Did post the professor it online?
The professor did post it online?

explanations.C: Não é forma de pergunta padrão.
explanations.general: Correct answer: Did the professor post it online?

questions.questionText: “I have a lot of reading for tomorrow.” Which response fits better?

options.text: Do you want me to help?
I like reading a lot.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Do you want me to help?

questions.questionText: Put in order: closes / it / at / today / six / but

options.text: But it closes at six today.

It closes but at six today.

explanations.general: Correct answer: But it closes at six today.

questions.questionText: Put in order: the notes / you / want / do / ? → Do you ______ the notes?
Put in order: the library / she / probably / is / in

options.text: She probably is in the library.
She is probably in the library.
Probably in the library she is.

explanations.A: Com be, o advérbio vem depois.
explanations.general: Correct answer: She is probably in the library.

questions.questionText: Put in order: harder / than / it / was / expected / I → It was harder than I ______.

explanations.general: It was harder than I expected.

questions.questionText: Put in order: I / using / sorry / am / it / now / right

options.text: Sorry, I am using it right now.
Sorry, I am right now using it.

explanations.general: Correct answer: Sorry, I am using it right now.

questions.questionText: Put in order: the deadline / she / until / Monday / extended → She ______ the deadline until Monday.
